review:
An underworld game where Hellhounds are cash multipliers, not wilds. At the end of each spin, hounds stretch to the top of their reel and their values are collected bottom-up, left to right, into a running total above each reel.

Adding hounds give 1x to 50x, multiplying hounds multiply that reel's total by x2 to x10 – so the order they land in matters. Reel totals add up and get multiplied by your bet. Only one hound per reel. 20,000x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
